name: Google Drives
author: Spencer Owen
description: Real two-way sync for multiple Google Drive accounts: bar status, storage usage, and pause/resume, backed by rclone bisync.

barWidget.description: Sign in to one or more Google Drive accounts, see two-way sync status and storage per account, and pause or resume syncing.

schema.label: Sync root
schema.description: Parent directory holding one two-way-synced folder per account, e.g. ~/GoogleDrive/Personal.

schema.label: Show storage usage in the panel
